from PIL import Image

def montage(names, out_path):
    imgs = [Image.open(f'crops/t_{n}.png') for n in names]
    max_h = max(im.height for im in imgs)
    total_w = sum(im.width for im in imgs)
    sheet = Image.new('L', (total_w, max_h))
    cur_x = 0
    for im in imgs:
        sheet.paste(im, (cur_x, 0))
        cur_x += im.width
    sheet.save(out_path)
